steps.name: Check this revision is still main
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
main_sha=$(gh api repos/porchlab/frontporch/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha)
if [[ "$main_sha" == "$GITHUB_SHA" ]]; then
  echo 'deploy=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo 'Skipped superseded revision.' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
fi

steps.name: Request the fixed host deployment
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
[[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
[[ "$DEPLOY_HOST" =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9.-]*$ ]]
[[ "$DEPLOY_USER" =~ ^[a-zA-Z_][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$ ]]
umask 077
work=$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/frontporch-deploy.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
printf '%s\n' "$DEPLOY_SSH_KEY" > "$work/key"
printf '%s\n' "$DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS" > "$work/known_hosts"
if ssh -F /dev/null -T -i "$work/key" -p 22 -l "$DEPLOY_USER" \
    -o BatchMode=yes -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes \
    -o UserKnownHostsFile="$work/known_hosts" -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null \
    -o ClearAllForwardings=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 \
    -o ServerAliveInterval=15 -o ServerAliveCountMax=3 \
    "$DEPLOY_HOST" "$GITHUB_SHA" > "$work/result" 2>&1; then
  echo "Deployed revision $GITHUB_SHA; host verification passed." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
else
  echo '::error::Deployment failed. Inspect private host deployment logs.'
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Check deployment policy and denial scenarios
steps.run:
python deploy/automation/check_workflows.py
python -m unittest discover -s tests/deployment -v
sh -n deploy/automation/receive.sh
